title: ⚡ Bolt: Replace .forEach() with for-loops in MutationObservers
body:
💡 What: Replaced `.forEach()` with standard block-scoped `for` loops in `youtubeAdRemover.ts` and `ytAdBlock2.ts` `MutationObserver` callbacks.
🎯 Why: High-frequency callbacks using `.forEach()` create excessive closure allocations that cause high garbage collection pressure, risking UI jank.
📊 Impact: Reduces memory allocation significantly on DOM-heavy mutation events (like YouTube navigating).
🔬 Measurement: Verify compiled artifacts and unit tests are green.
